title: Affine monodromy and exact value distributions over finite fields
summary: We study finite field value distributions through the fixed-point statistics of monodromy groups. For a regular degree-\(n\) cover, omitted values are controlled by derangements. Thus natural symmetric monodromy gives support density \(1-D_n/n!\to 1-e^{-1}\), while the Cameron--Cohen bound gives the universal ceiling \(1-1/n\), attained by sharply \(2\)-transitive affine monodromy. We give an explicit polynomial realization of this optimal mechanism.
